description: A low crete undercroft that hums. The building junction box hangs open-faced on the wall, a cliff of breakers labelled in three generations of tape, and a squat backup generator waits under a skin of dust for the grid to blink. Conduit climbs every wall toward the stage overhead; when the lamps up there pull full load, the whole room ticks like something cooling.
name: KSAB-TV Studio — Power Room
